claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Isoxsuprine is a beta-adrenergic agonist with cationic amphiphilic structure, so at 2.5 uM it most plausibly causes weak, non-selective lysosomal/physicochemical stress rather than adrenergic-receptor-mediated killing.
